description: An extreme Republican supermajority on the Supreme Court has now stripped women of their constitutional right to an abortion. I'm a strong supporter of the Women’s Health Protection Act, a bill to guarantee everyone access to abortion care no matter which state they live in. I’m also fighting for strong, commonsense policies that address the economic challenges facing women and families.
